class.name: Pipe
class.brief_description: Generates a pipe mesh along a [Curve3D].
class.description:
Builds a tube mesh from [member curve], with optional elbow shaping and separate materials for straight and elbow sections.
Elbows are generated at curve points with no in/out handles. The have a flange length and an elbow length which are adjustable.

members.member: The source curve used to generate the pipe path.
Number of sides used for the tube cross-section. Higher values produce a rounder pipe.
Radius of the generated pipe tube.
UV twist/repeat factor along the pipe length.
Radius used to construct elbow bend arcs.
Length of the straight transition entering and exiting an elbow section.
Scale multiplier applied to the elbow section profile.
Length of flange transition segments around elbows.
Scale multiplier applied to flange transition segments.
Material assigned to the straight pipe surface.
